summary: I could envision something like @manton's microblog being close to #IndieWeb learning environment I am hacking on with new ActivityPub. Each class spin up an instance, Connect at school, discipline level. Would need easy install/hosting but be fun. #mb
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I could envision something like @manton's microblog being close to #IndieWeb learning environment I am hacking on with new ActivityPub.

Each class spin up an instance, Connect at school, discipline level. Would need easy install/hosting but be fun. #mb
